outcome: Give Telco teams a working CSP Customer 360 & Cross-Sell / Upsell Engine capability on their own data — it lifts ARPU and cross-sell conversion through relevance.
overview: A subscriber looks different in BSS, in OSS, in the care system and in the app, so the operator cannot say with confidence who a customer is — let alone what to offer them next. CSP Customer 360 & Cross-Sell / Upsell Engine stitches those identities into one governed view and runs propensity models over it, so data add-ons, fixed wireless, fibre, bundles and B2B upgrades go to subscribers with a reason to buy rather than to the whole base. Marketing efficiency improves because fewer offers reach the wrong people. The five-week MVP runs on the operator's own data and leaves behind an identity foundation that other use cases plug into.
